ValidationRule.description: Contract and distribution name is required for particular type in Deal support cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR ( ISPICKVAL(Type,'Audit Compliance'),ISPICKVAL(Type,'Deal Amendment'),ISPICKVAL(Type,'Deal Extension'),ISPICKVAL(Type,'Deal Renewal'),ISPICKVAL(Type,'Deal Termination'),ISPICKVAL(Type,' New Deal Load')), OR( ISBLANK(Related_Contract__c),ISBLANK(Distribution_Email__c)), RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Deal_Support_request' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter value in the Related Contract and Distribution Email
